answer: A farm of 343 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in nectar, queued in cedar, and sparrow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 21 identities per epoch. A farm of 4825 identities would post 2878 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
